listing.name: Neverball
listing.summary: Tilt the floor to roll a ball through obstacle courses and collect enough coins to open the goal.
listing.download_block_reason: The stable Windows ZIP is on Neverball’s original release host. Use that ZIP or your Linux package manager for the desktop game.

steps.title: Run the stable Windows player
steps.instruction: Download and extract the complete neverball-1.6.0.zip from Neverball’s Downloads page. Keep data and the included DLLs beside neverball.exe in the neverball-1.6.0 folder. Start neverball.exe with Windows support for 32-bit applications.

steps.title: Install the Linux game through your package manager
steps.instruction: Install neverball from Debian or Ubuntu and let your package manager install the common files, levels and runtime libraries. Start Neverball with a working OpenGL driver.

steps.title: Keep your runs and settings
steps.instruction: Close the desktop game and copy the full Neverball folder in Documents/My Games on Windows or ~/.neverball on Linux. It contains your settings, records and replays. Keep custom levels you added to the installation separately before replacing the package.

references.title: Play in a browser on desktop or mobile
references.instruction: The official browser build supports touch controls on mobile, including Android. Use the browser link on modern Macs. The older Mac 1.5.3 installer contains only PowerPC and 32-bit Intel code.

references.title: Play the companion Neverputt game
references.instruction: On Windows, run neverputt.exe from the same extracted 1.6.0 folder and keep the included data and libraries beside it. On Debian or Ubuntu, install the neverputt package with its data dependencies. In Neverputt, choose Play, a course, and one to four players to play on the same computer. On Linux, back up the shared ~/.neverball folder to keep its settings.

references.title: Find Neverputt on Mac
references.instruction: If you use MacPorts, its neverball port installs Neverputt separately. Open Neverputt under Applications/MacPorts or start neverputt from a terminal. The older official disk image contains a 32-bit Intel and PowerPC Neverputt installer. The project’s mobile browser link is for Neverball.
